title: Beyond Consumer Switching: Supply Responses to Food Packaging and Advertising Regulations
eligible_reason: Single national policy. Chile's Food Labeling and Advertising Law took effect in June 2016 for all products at once. Reduced-form supply responses compare Chile with other Latin American countries in Mintel data (lm(y ~ Post:Chile + factor(Year) + factor(COUNTRY)), one treated country, one date) or run Chile-only pre/post regressions with year dummies and linear trends; price responses use Post plus above-threshold indicators. Demand estimation is a nested-logit IV (ivreghdfe) with product-region and month FE; demo_rdd.do is a threshold RDD. No unit-specific adoption dates.
design_notes: Python build (codePython), R reduced-form output (codeR/demo_output_supply_response.R, demo_func_price_response.R, demo_output_demand_response.R), Stata demand/counterfactuals (codeStata/demo_demand.do, demo_bootstrap.do, demo_rdd.do, demo_oecd.do). All files prefixed 'demo_' run on generated demo data.
data_provenance_note: README: DemoMintelData.xlsx and DemoSalesData.xlsx are demo datasets created by codePython/generate_data.py with randomly generated brands, nutritional content, volumes and prices standing in for the licensed Mintel GNPD and Nielsen Chile data. Hand-collected nutrition files are original.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). One treated country and one policy date; main data synthetic.
